newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy up, nearby corn, wheat flat.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy up, nearby corn, wheat flat.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf nearby corn offers were flat and soybean offers were up slightly Friday in quiet activity, U.S. exporters said.
"It was a very quiet day in the FOB markets," said one corn exporter.
Cash traders were still monitoring traffic on Midwest rivers leading to the Gulf. Another blast of cold air has been forecast, which could cause new icing problems, they said.
In late-day export news, Egyptian government officials announced a tender for 110,000 tonnes of No. 2 or better U.S. or Australian wheat.
The news should offer wheat prices support, but most exporters expect Egypt to take the more competitively priced Australian wheat.
